notes: M21 G2 spec: Alpine Houndmaster. 'search your library for a card named Alpine Watchdog and/or a card named Igneous Cur': at most ONE card of each name. With two Watchdogs in the library, taking the first leaves the second unavailable. Re-pinned 2026-11-05 (strict decision words; the pack used to answer the second pick with 'dog2', which only the silent fallback made pass): the first Houndmaster's search is two picks, the Watchdog's (dog1, dog2, NONE: the pack takes dog1) and the Cur's (cur, NONE: the pack takes cur), so one of each comes to hand and the second Watchdog stays. A second Houndmaster then enters and searches again: 'fire', then NONE at its Watchdog pick. Its Cur pick has nothing to find, so nothing more is asked and dog2 stays in the library (hand: drawn, dog1, cur). If any pick but the Watchdog's could take a Watchdog, dog2 reaches the hand and the pack fails: with the old single up-to-two pick over both names (before 620a7ad) the second Houndmaster's pick is forced onto dog2; with a Cur pick widened to both names, the second Houndmaster meets one more pick, which the pack has no word for (the runner then takes its first word, dog2).
